limitations.note: The agent correctly fixed the counter's handshake condition but also removed `ready_b` from the accumulator-load condition, so the first accepted byte of a group replaces rather than adds to the prior sum when downstream is not ready.

The scoreboard assumed every group starts from zero regardless of `ready_b`, so its backpressure tests validated the extra change instead of detecting the mismatch with the behavior the fix was supposed to preserve.
